confirmed_root_causes: Artifact Provider request JSON can arrive at the Go runner with an UTF-8 BOM on Windows PowerShell redirected stdin; encoding is now explicitly no-BOM and the provider defensively accepts one leading UTF-8 BOM
Browser live-capture policy omitted explicit hidden_capture and credential_export fields while the StrictMode acceptance expected them
terminal status duplicate detection reused parent commandId, so the initial job.submit ACK falsely satisfied existing-bubble detection; status events now carry a unique eventId
PowerShell throw keyword adjacency such as throw"Unknown action..." is unsafe under Windows PowerShell 5.1 and is normalized/static-guarded
gh --log-failed hides continue-on-error root steps; CI helper now reads one full log, groups failed step logs locally, stores full evidence, and returns bounded root excerpts
component_note: RC7 full CI component failure occurs after provider-dependent setup; RC8 does not claim a separate component root cause until exact-RC Windows CI validates it.
